Title: Adding a new shop with a phone number already registered as a customer
Preconditions: User is logged in as an admin with permissions to add shops. A customer with phone number '0712345678' already exists in the system.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Add New Shop' page. 2. Fill in the shop details with a unique shop name, owner name, address, and area. 3. Enter the phone number '0712345678' (already registered as a customer). 4. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Shop Name: 'QuickFix Electronics', Owner Name: 'John Doe', Address: '123 Main St', Area: 'Downtown', Phone Number: '0712345678'
Expected Result: The system displays an error message: 'This Phone Number Already Used'. The shop is not added to the system.
